title: On Counting the coins twice before paying
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：count　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 count 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the planner ① counted the coins twice before paying at once, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② counts the coins twice before paying in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ count the coins twice before paying at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ counted the coins twice before paying before — a line in the report for March 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Counting the coins twice before paying at once, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ count as one of the oldest houses in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Count as one of the oldest houses at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ counts as one of the oldest houses at once every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ counted the coins twice before paying again when nobody else would.

⑩ To count the coins twice before paying, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody counts the coins twice before paying in the rain again and somebody must count the coins twice before paying at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 清点（一般过去式 counted the coins twice before paying：1981 年规划员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 清点（一般现在 counts the coins twice before paying：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 清点（不定式 to count the coins twice before paying：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 清点（过去完成时 had counted the coins twice before paying：1975 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 清点（动名词 counting the coins twice before paying 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 算得上（count as one of the oldest houses：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去算得上算得上最老的宅子之一）
G. v. 算得上（count as one of the oldest houses：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 清点（后段两处：新来的市民照例 counts as one of the oldest houses，而母亲又一次 counted the coins twice before paying）

answers.why: count 意为“清点”，1981 年规划员二话不说地清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 counted。
count 意为“清点”，自那以后规划员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 counts。
count 意为“清点”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍”，此处为不定式 to count the coins twice before paying。
count 意为“清点”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人清点过，故用过去完成时 had counted。
count 意为“清点”，规划员说“清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 counting the coins twice before paying 作主语。
count 意为“算得上”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去算得上算得上最老的宅子之一”，should ever 之后用原形 count as one of the oldest houses。
count 意为“算得上”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻算得上算得上最老的宅子之一（count as one of the oldest houses at once），以后再也不要提起。
count 意为“清点”，新来的市民每个年份都照例算得上算得上最老的宅子之一，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 counts。
count 意为“清点”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍，用一般过去式 counted 叙述。
count 意为“清点”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

items: 1981 年，规划员二话不说地清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（counted the coins twice before paying）
多年以后，规划员仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（counts the coins twice before paying）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍这件事本身。（to count the coins twice before paying）
早在 1975 年就有人清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍，三月那天规划报告上的一行字就是证据。（had counted the coins twice before paying）
规划员说过，二话不说地清点付钱前把铜钱数上两遍这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（counting the coins twice before paying 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻算得上算得上最老的宅子之一，以后再也不要提起。（count as one of the oldest houses，祈使句）

Three years on, the planner still counts the coins twice before paying in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to count the coins twice before paying at all was the part nobody had expected.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 count 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the planner counted the coins twice before paying at once, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner counts the coins twice before paying in the rain whenever the district asks.
Counting the coins twice before paying at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever count as one of the oldest houses in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district counts as one of the oldest houses at once every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother counted the coins twice before paying again, and the district remembered that half.
